# Bambu Labs

Stand-in SKILL.md written for the BuildBot tests, in our own words. The real
skill is in [earthtojake/text-to-cad](https://github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad).

The skill opens a file in Bambu Lab's own app and stops there: the owner picks
the printer and presses Print. It never drives a printer and never asks for an
access code. Bambu Lab explains how other programs hand files over at
https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/software/third-party-integration.

Before the owner prints, remind them to check the printer, the plate, the
filament and that someone stays nearby for the first layer.
